about_the_game:
"Experience the future of sport"

Drone Soccer game mode brings high-speed, high-skill action to your game. Take control of your drone and compete in an electrifying sport where flying, passing, and scoring happen mid-air.

Master the arena, outmaneuver your rivals, and hit the target with style — welcome to the future of competitive drone sports.

Short match times and fast rounds make Drone Soccer endlessly replayable. Jump in for a quick match or lose yourself in a full evening of high-stakes drone sport.

ARENA ACTION

Each match takes place in a futuristic enclosed arena, designed to keep the action intense and up-close. Walls, ceilings, and bounce zones open up opportunities for creative plays, ricochets, and jaw-dropping shots.

TRAINING

New to drone soccer? No worries — Training mode is your onboard training ground. Start with the basics and quickly progress to advanced maneuvers like tight turns, aerial dribbling, bank shots, and mid-air recoveries. Each module is designed to build muscle memory and give you full control of your drone.

KICKOFF

Jump straight into the action with Quick Play mode – a fast and fun way to play casual matches. Face off against computer in balanced matches that keep the pace tight and the tension high. 

By freely switching or replaying matches from different roles, you’ll get to experience all positions on the field and develop a complete understanding of team dynamics and aerial tactics.

CAREER

Start your journey as a rookie and work your way up through the global leader board in Career Mode, where every match, challenge, and objective contributes to your growth in the world of drone sports.
